snippet.title: Noctheria – Teaser Trailer A Zelda-like Survival Horror
snippet.description:
🌑 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776070/Noctheria/

Step into the shadows of Noctheria — a retro horror adventure inspired by Silent Hill, Resident Evil and Zelda, and the haunting silence of forgotten places.

🕯️ In Noctheria, you're not just exploring a cursed land… you're uncovering buried memories, facing spiritual horrors, and surviving a surreal nightmare.

🕹️ Retro horror with dungeon-crawling, puzzles, and a N64-style world that feels disturbingly alive.


🧵 Follow development and dive deeper into the darkness:
🐦 Twitter/X –https://x.com/ZombieByteGames
🔴 Discord – https://discord.com/invite/GgDjeAfHtq

If you love Survival horror, psychological tension, or just miss that Silent Hill, Resident Evil or old school 3D Zelda games, you're going to love what’s coming.
